main_text.p: Ex facultatis robore, siue ex ictus uel robo ris uitalis qualitate, differentiæ tres:
Ex motus genere, siue ex ictus qualitate, tres:
Hæc quinque pulsuum genera in vno mo tu consistunt arteriæ.

page.notes: Italic throughout the lower part; the words of the list lines 23–27 are in italic. The catchword "Cum" at lower right is set as the last line of the page, so it is given as a paragraph. Ligature-like abbreviations (moderatᵒ, tumidᵒ) transcribed as printed with superscript marks.
